svg.title: Subagents: hand a task to another agent run
svg.desc: The parent model calls delegate_task with an agent name and a self-contained task. SubAgents checks that the name is in the roster, that the delegate has calls left in its max_calls budget and that the tree is not deeper than max_depth, then runs that agent, such as researcher, writer or self, in its own run with its own message history and the parent's deps, usage and workspace. The child's output comes back as the tool result; a timeout or an exhausted budget comes back as a steering message, and a child error as a retry.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
